dimensions.detail: The skill is coherently scoped to competitor SEO/GEO analysis: gathering competitor URLs, metrics, keywords, backlinks, content patterns, and producing a prioritized competitive brief and action plan.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are task-focused and include safeguards such as asking for competitors when needed and labeling metrics as measured, user-provided, or estimated; no prompt override, deception, credential harvesting, or unrelated authority was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown skill files and reference templates only. There are duplicate ' 2.md' copies, but their hashes match the primary files and they do not add executable behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Optional web/SEO tooling and a Firecrawl connector command are proportionate for competitor research, and the artifact says the connector checks robots.txt; the connector itself is referenced but not bundled here.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly promotes competitor facts, keyword priorities, entity candidates, and pending strategy decisions into memory files. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but it may retain sensitive business context beyond the current task.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The memory-write concern is artifact-backed: the skill tells the agent to save reusable summaries and promote competitor/strategy facts to memory paths. Because this persistence is explicit, scoped to the analysis workflow, and not hidden or unrelated, it warrants user awareness rather than a Review verdict.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is clean, and there is no artifact evidence that would contradict that signal.
[staticScan] expected: The static scan reported no suspicious patterns; local inspection likewise found only markdown instructions/templates and no bundled executable scripts or install hooks.
llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to help produce competitor SEO and positioning research. Before using it on confidential strategy, be aware that it asks the agent to save summaries and durable competitor facts into memory; use an ephemeral workspace or remove/redact sensitive details if that retention is not desired.
llm.summary: This is a text-only competitor research skill whose disclosed memory saving and optional web research fit its stated purpose, with no evidence of hidden or destructive behavior.
